external_games.name: Space Chase II: Fortress of Doom!

name: Space Chase II: Fortress of Doom!
storyline: Jason Storm who hails from Galaxy 239 is a veteran of the Marines who takes on mercenary jobs. After rescuing Capital City from Evil Guys, he chased them to their island fortress. Will he be able to track down and capture Mr. Big?
summary: Jason Storm chases after alien invaders in this 2D platformer. Solve puzzles, jump over Slime Devils and PatrolBots if you can’t find a vantage point which lets you shoot them, and be careful to not run out of ammo!
